🌟 **Celebrating Little Learners & Big Achievements!** 🌟

Our **Celebration of Learning** was a beautiful opportunity to see our little ones shine! 💛✨

From confidently sharing what they have learned to showcasing their skills, creativity, curiosity, and growing independence, every moment was filled with smiles and pride. 🌈🧒👧

It was heartwarming to see our children express themselves, demonstrate their learning, and celebrate their journey with their teachers and parents. 🥰👏

Because every little step is a milestone, and every achievement deserves to be celebrated! 🎉🌱

✨ **Learn • Explore • Grow • Celebrate** ✨

🔢✨ **Learning Numbers with Spindle Box!** ✨🌱

Our little learners explored the **Spindle Box activity**—a wonderful hands-on way to build early mathematical understanding! 🧮💛

Through counting and placing the correct number of spindles into each compartment, children practised **quantification, one-to-one correspondence, number recognition, counting skills, and number sense**. 🔢🤲

🌟 **What they learned:**
• Recognising numbers and quantities
• Counting objects accurately
• Understanding one-to-one correspondence
• Connecting numerals with quantities
• Developing concentration and fine motor skills

Learning becomes meaningful when little hands get to **count, touch, explore, and discover!** 🌈💫

🟢 **Jump, Hop & Have Fun! 🐰✨**

Our little learners had a wonderful time with our **“Jump in Hoops” Gross Motor Activity!** 🌈

Through jumping, balancing, and moving through hoops, children strengthened their **gross motor skills, coordination, balance, body control, and spatial awareness**—all while having lots of fun! 🤸‍♀️💪

Every jump is a little step towards becoming more confident, active, and independent! 🌟💚

🍎🍊 **Match the Pom-Pom to the Fruit!** 🍌🍇

Learning is more fun when little hands get involved! 🌈✨ Our little learners enjoyed a fun **colour-matching activity** by matching colourful pom-poms with the corresponding fruits. 🍎🟡🟢

This engaging activity helped children:
🎨 Recognise and identify colours
🍓 Improve visual discrimination
🧠 Strengthen concentration and memory
🤲 Develop fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination
🌱 Learn about fruits through hands-on play

A simple activity with lots of learning, exploration, and smiles! 💕✨

**Celebrating the Pride of India!** 

Our little learners explored the **National Symbols of India** through a fun and engaging learning activity! 🌟📚

From our **National Flag to the National Animal 🐅, National Bird 🦚, National Flower 🌸 and National Fruit 🥭**, the children discovered the beautiful symbols that represent our incredible country.

Learning about our nation’s identity helps children build **awareness, curiosity and a sense of pride** from an early age. ❤️

🌈 **Learn • Explore • Discover • Celebrate India!**

🦚💙 **Krishna Janmashtami Celebrations at Little Oaks!** 🪈✨

Our little ones celebrated the beautiful festival of **Krishna Janmashtami** with lots of joy, laughter, and festive spirit! 🌸💛

Dressed in adorable traditional attire, our little Krishna and Radhas added extra charm to the celebration. 🦚👑 The children enjoyed festive activities, music, dance, and joyful moments as they learned about the birth of **Lord Krishna** and the values of love, kindness, and togetherness. 💙✨

It was a day filled with **smiles, celebration, and beautiful memories!** 🌼🎶

💙 *Celebrating traditions, creating memories, and growing together at Little Oaks!* 🌿

🐒🧢 **STORY TIME: THE CAP SELLER AND THE MONKEYS!** 🧢🐒

Once upon a time, a clever cap seller had a surprising encounter with a group of mischievous monkeys! 🌳🐒

Our little learners enjoyed this fun and interactive story, bringing the characters to life with their expressions, actions, and lots of giggles! 📖✨

Through storytelling, children develop **listening skills, imagination, vocabulary, communication, memory, and social-emotional understanding**. 🌈🧠

Every story is a new adventure, and every little listener is a storyteller in the making! ❤️📚

A Teacher in Every Person. ❤️

This Teacher’s Day, we chose to celebrate a little differently — with laughter, adventure, and our entire team at Sugee Resorts! 🌿✨

Because we believe that learning doesn’t happen only in classrooms. We learn from every person we meet, every experience we share, and every challenge we overcome.

Some teach us patience.
Some teach us courage.
Some teach us kindness.
Some teach us to simply enjoy the moment. 😊

Today was our way of celebrating and expressing gratitude to the teacher in every person who inspires us, guides us, challenges us, and helps us grow.

Here’s to a day filled with adventure, unforgettable memories, and a team that keeps learning from one another. 🫶

Happy Teacher’s Day — to every teacher, and to the teacher within each of us! 🌸

#TeachersDay #TeacherInEveryPerson #Gratitude #TeamCelebration #TeamLittleOaks TeamArtKlub LearningTogether GrowingTogether AdventureTogether WorkFamily CelebrateLearning

🎈 **BLOW THE BALL ACTIVITY! ⚽💨**

Learning through play! Our little learners had fun blowing the ball using their mouths and guiding it towards the target. 🌟

This simple yet engaging activity helps develop **oral strength, breath control, concentration, and gross motor skills** while making learning exciting and enjoyable! 🧒👧✨

💨 Strengthening those little muscles
🎯 Improving focus & coordination
🫁 Encouraging breath control
🏃‍♀️ Developing gross motor skills
😊 Learning through joyful play

At **Little Oaks Preschool**, every activity is designed to make learning active, meaningful, and fun! 🌱💛
